name: Product characteristic identification code
description: Code specifying the identification of a product characteristic.

values.name: TCV
values.description: TCV TCV tariff is applicable for the given travel service (TCV = Tarif Commun Voyageurs, ordinary tariff for travellers).

values.name: Global tariff
values.description: Global tariff All inclusive tariff is applicable for the given travel service.

values.name: East - West tariff
values.description: East - West tariff Tariff used for traffic from east to west or vice versa.

values.name: No published tariff
values.description: No published tariff There is no published tariff for the service.

values.name: Train with TCV or Market Price
values.description: Train with TCV or Market Price Train running with service that can be sold at TCV (Tarif Commun Voyageurs - ordinary tariff for travellers) or Market Price.
